title: 离岸
standfirst: 粗绳盘在近处，船沿岸靠拢；拉开距离以后，水面露出另一条路。
standfirstEn: Rope coils nearby as boats gather along the shore. Farther out, another route appears on the water.
introduction: 帆船与远岸之间留着大片蓝绿的水面。另一幅里，粗绳盘在绿漆甲板上，橙色救生圈贴着金属边缘。船可以很小，也可以近到只剩一截外壳。
七幅照片沿着船与岸的间距展开：平坦的船体在港口靠拢，人聚在码头前的甲板上，篷顶和屋檐把水道收窄。再从高处望下去，船在楼群之间转弯，一条浅色航迹随之展开。水面的空处，留下了经过的方向。
introductionEn: A broad stretch of blue-green water lies between sailboats and a distant shore. In another photograph, thick rope coils on a green-painted deck beside orange life rings and metal edges. A boat can appear small, or come so close that only part of its shell remains.

Seven photographs follow the distance between boats and the shore: flat hulls gather in a harbour, people occupy a deck beside a pier, and canopies and eaves narrow a channel. Seen from above, a boat turns between buildings and a pale wake spreads behind it. Open water keeps a direction of passage.

chapters.title: 靠拢
chapters.text: 船体、甲板与篷顶在岸边排列；吊臂、柱廊和屋檐仍在后面。水面从它们之间显出来，有时是一块空处，有时只剩窄窄的缝。
chapters.textEn: Hulls, decks and canopies line the shore, with cranes, columns and eaves behind them. Water appears between these forms, sometimes as an open space, sometimes as a narrow gap.

chapters.title: 拉开
chapters.text: 从高处望下去，岸上的建筑把水道围成一道弯，小船在其中留下更细的转折。间隔拉开以后，水面留住了经过的方向。
chapters.textEn: Seen from above, buildings enclose a broad bend in the waterway. A boat leaves a finer turn within it. As distance opens, the water retains a direction of passage.
